Let's go, I'll meet you right over on my Instagram account.

We'll simply send this message, wait for the reply, and see what our setter says.
We can see it's asking whether I've already started selling or if I'm just getting started.
So I tell it I've already made a million. Then it asks what I'm currently selling.
I answer: dog products.
To which it replies: That's a great niche. How long have you been doing e-com?
I answer: two years.
Have I tried finding winning products?
So I tell it I'm currently checking Pinterest Trends, and then it says: Ah, but what do you think is holding you back from hitting 10K a month with your e-com store?
So I tell it: the right sources, and maybe the skills to make better ads or better stores.

I say yes, why not. It gives me a recap and tells me the next step is a 30-minute call.
I tell it I'm in.
It sends me the link.
I tell it I booked my call for the next day at 4 p.m., and it says: Perfect, see you at 4.
The prompt we used only took five minutes to put together.
So imagine: if you fine-tune your setting script, you can get insane results.

You can see the conversation, you can even take it over yourself, so it's awesome.
Sync ManySetter with ManyChat, and you'll never lose a single lead again.
I hope you enjoyed this video.
If you have any questions, feel free to ask me in the comments.

Thanks, everyone, and see you next time!
